characters.name: Veya
characters.description: A sharp-eyed cartographer from Silverspine Academy who maps the fading skybridges.
characters.motivation: To prove her late mentor's theory that the isles are drifting apart.
characters.goal: Chart a safe route through the breaking skybridge network.
characters.flaw: Cannot admit when she is wrong.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants recognition but fears becoming like the ambitious cartel leaders.
characters.external_conflict: The Drift Cartel wants her new charts buried.

abilities.name: Wind-sight
abilities.description: Reads the subtle colours of wind currents to predict bridge movement.

characters.arc: Veya learns that some truths are safer shared than hoarded.

characters.name: Kael
characters.description: A toll-master for the Drift Cartel who believes trade must be regulated at any cost.
characters.motivation: To secure the Cartel's monopoly before the bridges collapse.
characters.goal: Seize the last stable skybridge routes.
characters.internal_conflict: He admires Veya's skill but cannot let her succeed.
characters.external_conflict: The Bridge Wardens accuse him of sabotaging forge-island supplies.

abilities.name: Ledger-mastery
abilities.description: Instantly sees the weakest point in any trading arrangement.

characters.arc: Kael discovers that control costs more than it gains.

characters.name: Maris
characters.description: A miller's daughter from The Hollow who knows every secret grain silo in the archipelago.
characters.motivation: To protect her isle from the grain levy.
characters.goal: Smuggle enough grain to keep The Hollow fed through the crisis.
characters.flaw: She trusts slowly and rarely forgives.
characters.internal_conflict: She must choose between loyalty to home and her growing friendship with Veya.
characters.external_conflict: Cartel enforcers are closing in on her smuggling routes.

abilities.name: Pathfinding
abilities.description: Knows the unmapped service corridors between windmills and granaries.

characters.arc: Maris realises that hiding can be as brave as standing still.

relationships.description: They were apprentices together; now they stand on opposite sides of the toll war.
relationships.conflict: Kael wants Veya's charts, but she refuses to let him control them.

relationships.description: Veya trades wind-current knowledge for Maris's secret paths.
